name: relation-to-wheel
title: Relation to Wheel
description: How a source relates to the Wheel of Heaven canon. Set on every source bibliography entry.

values.label: Foundational
values.description: Constitutes the foundational canon. Raëlian sources only.

values.label: Comparative Primary
values.description: A primary tradition the canon reads alongside the foundational corpus.

values.label: Revelatory Continuation
values.description: A modern revelatory tradition treated as continuing the conversation the canon engages.

values.label: Critical Context
values.description: Methodological or skeptical critique that bounds the reading.

values.label: Supplementary
values.description: Pedagogical or tangential — never primary support.
